CommunityApplications.Profile: Templates for Tunefish's self-hosted apps: Tapeory (design, store and print Brother P-touch labels from your browser), Satisfactory Map Renderer (an interactive map of your Satisfactory save game) and Tilorama (a fast deep-zoom viewer for gigapixel images). Each app has its own GitHub repository with the source, documentation and Discussions for questions; please report bugs there as GitHub issues.
